# Colossal

> > An independent online art magazine celebrating contemporary visual culture through artist profiles, exhibitions, photography, and explorations of craft and the natural world.

Colossal is a curated platform featuring 7,500+ articles on contemporary art, photography, sculpture, and installation work. The site offers membership support, visual search tools, art terminology resources, and multiple newsletter subscriptions for art enthusiasts and professionals.

## Key Topics

- Contemporary Art
- Artist Profiles
- Photography
- Sculpture
- Installation Art
- Painting
- Public Art
- Craft
- Art Exhibitions
- Yayoi Kusama
- Visual Culture
- Membership Support
- Art Terminology
- Natural World
- Independent Publishing

## Core Platform

- [Colossal Homepage](https://www.thisiscolossal.com): Homepage for independent online art magazine celebrating visual culture.
- [Search for Art: Explore Colossal with Visual Search](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/explore): Visual search tool to explore 7,500+ contemporary art articles.
- [Subscribe to Art Newsletters from Colossal](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/newsletter): Newsletter subscription hub with Daily Dose, Weekly, and Chicago art options.
- [Art Term Glossary by Colossal](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/glossary): Art terminology and definitions reference for students and learners.

## Membership & Support

- [Colossal Membership: Support Independent Arts Publishing](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/members): Membership program with supporter tiers and patron benefits.
- [About Colossal](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/about): Organization mission, team, and information about Colossal magazine.
- [Contact Colossal](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/contact): Contact page for submissions, advertising, and editorial inquiries.

## Contemporary Artist Profiles

- [Ben Zank's Portraits Teeter Between Surrealism and the Mundane](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/03/ben-zank-surreal-portraits): Artist profile of Ben Zank's surreal portrait photography.
- [Breezy Swathes of Fabric Dance Amid Landscapes in Thomas Jackson's Photos](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/03/thomas-jackson-fabrics-landscapes-photographs): Artist profile of Thomas Jackson's fabric and landscape photography.
- [Restrained Emotions Simmer in Shinsuke Inoue's Tender Wood Sculptures](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/03/shinsuke-inoue-carved-wood-figures-sculptures): Artist profile of Shinsuke Inoue's carved wood figure sculptures.
- [Nostalgia and Decay Meet Theatricality in Andrew Moore's Dramatic Photos](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/03/andrew-moore-theater-architecture-nostalgia-photographs): Photographer profile of Andrew Moore's atmospheric architectural images.
- [Pejac Transforms Basic Graph Paper into Detailed, Trompe-L'œil Tableaux](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/03/pejac-graph-paper-graphite-drawings): Artist profile of Pejac's trompe-l'œil graphite drawings on graph paper.

## Architecture & Sculpture

- [Marc Fornes' New Sculptural Pavilion Reimagines the Architectural Folly](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/03/marc-fornes-lile-folie-sculpture-pavilion-north-carolina): Profile of Marc Fornes' L'Ile Folie sculptural pavilion in Cary, NC.

## Exhibition Reviews

- ['Let Us Gather In a Flourishing Way' Convenes 58 Artists to Survey Contemporary Latinx Painting](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/03/let-us-gather-in-a-flourishing-way): Exhibition review of contemporary Latinx painting survey at Buffalo AKG.
- [Cosmic Nature: A Spectacular Polka Dot-Filled Exhibition by Yayoi Kusama](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2021/04/yayoi-kusama-cosmic-nature): Exhibition review of Yayoi Kusama's Cosmic Nature at NY Botanical Garden.
- [An Enormous Red Sun Shines Above New York in a Thanksgiving Parade Balloon by Yayoi Kusama](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2019/11/balloon-by-yayoi-kusama): Coverage of Yayoi Kusama's Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade balloon.
- [Take a Walk Through Yayoi Kusama's 'Narcissus Garden' Inside an Abandoned Factory in the Rockaways](https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2018/07/yayoi-kusamas-narcissus-garden-the-rockaways): Exhibition review of Yayoi Kusama's Narcissus Garden in Rockaways.
